clue.text: Abandoned lake outside lonely place

indicators.note: abandoned behaviour is wild and unrestrained, so the letters run loose into a new order

parts.note: L is the standard map abbreviation for lake
taken as written, as anagram fodder

explanation.surface: A deserted lake lies beyond some remote spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' looks like a container signal but is anagram fodder: L plus OUTSIDE, rearranged under 'Abandoned', gives the eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitude is a state of being alone, and by extension a secluded, isolated spot.

clue.text: The bird is soaring — to hide?

indicators.note: soaring means going up, so in a down clue the word is is turned upwards

parts.note: a hide is an animal's skin

explanation.surface: A bird flying high, perhaps to conceal itself.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'soaring' reads IS bottom-to-top, SI; 'hide' is a noun, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A siskin is a small yellow-green finch.

clue.text: English lesson so variable, showing laxity

indicators.note: variable means changeable, so these letters can be put in another order

explanation.surface: An English class of such uneven quality shows slackness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variable' rearranges E plus LESSON SO.
explanation.definitionFit: Looseness is slackness, a lack of strictness or tightness.

clue.text: A bit of salad is a small part of the problem

definitions.meaning: the top of a crisp lettuce variety

definitions.text: a small part of the problem
definitions.meaning: the visible fraction of a much larger difficulty

explanation.surface: A morsel of greens is just a minor element of what's wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally the top of a crisp lettuce, and idiomatically a small visible sign of a far larger hidden issue, like a mostly submerged floe.

clue.text: Sound measure destroyed bed lice

indicators.note: destroyed means broken up, so these letters are taken apart and rebuilt

explanation.surface: An infested bed has been fumigated and its parasites killed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroyed' rearranges BED LICE.
explanation.definitionFit: A decibel is the unit used to express loudness.

clue.text: Makes confession now when switching drink

indicators.note: switching the letters round shuffles the word now into a new order

parts.note: to sup is to drink, in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: Someone admits something right now while changing what they are drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'switching' turns NOW into OWN; SUP follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is an idiom for admitting guilt, which is confessing.

clue.text: One moves in a circle partly to clear the view

definitions.text: One moves in a circle partly to clear the view

parts.words: One moves in a circle partly to clear the view
parts.note: a rubber-bladed arm sweeping through an arc over a car's front glass to clear rain

explanation.surface: Something sweeps in an arc to give a clear sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'partly' means it moves through part of a circle, an arc.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's wiper sweeps through an arc across the front glass to clear rain from the driver's view.

clue.text: Has struck a blow attached to head of military

indicators.note: struck suggests a battering, so the letters of has are knocked into a new order

parts.note: KO is a knockout blow in boxing

explanation.surface: Someone has hit an army commander.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head of military' looks like a pick of M, but is the definition: headgear worn by soldiers; 'attached to' joins it.
explanation.definitionFit: A shako is a tall peaked cylindrical military hat with a plume.

clue.text: Deny part that's obscure in observance of petty rules

indicators.note: something obscure is unclear or muddled, so these letters come out in a jumble

explanation.surface: A denial that's unclear is about sticking to minor regulations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's obscure' rearranges DENY PART.
explanation.definitionFit: Pedantry is excessive concern with minor details and formal rules.

clue.text: Apparently fizzy ale is the request

parts.note: app. is a dictionary abbreviation for apparently

indicators.note: fizzy suggests bubbling up, so the letters of ale are stirred

explanation.surface: It seems a sparkling beer is what was asked for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fizzy' rearranges ALE into EAL.
explanation.definitionFit: An appeal is an earnest plea or request.

clue.text: Ship in small amounts of water coming back

indicators.note: coming back means the word for small amounts of water is read from right to left

parts.note: pools are small bodies of standing water

explanation.surface: A vessel sits in puddles as it returns to port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns POOLS round.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloop is a kind of single-masted sailing vessel.

clue.text: Holding official headdress but showing humility

parts.note: a cap is headwear worn as part of an official uniform
something held is in hand

explanation.surface: An officer clutches a uniform hat yet appears meek.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in the reverse of the clue's order: the headdress first, then 'Holding'.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming cap in hand is an idiom for approaching someone humbly to ask a favour, hat removed in deference.

clue.text: Exceptionally fine fiction is indescribable

indicators.note: exceptionally suggests something out of the ordinary, so the letters of fine are rearranged

parts.note: a fable is a made-up story

explanation.surface: A remarkably good novel is beyond words.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exceptionally' looks like it qualifies 'fine' but it rearranges FINE into INEF.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ineffable is too great or extreme to be expressed in words.

clue.text: A stirrer in the club?

definitions.meaning: a utensil used to mix tea or soup
a lofted wooden golf club of old was called by this name

explanation.surface: A troublemaker is found among the members of a society.
explanation.definitionFit: The kitchen utensil stirs liquids, and an old golf club with a hollowed face shared its name.

clue.text: All the twists could be potentially deadly

indicators.note: twists signals that the letters of all the are wrung into a different order

explanation.surface: All the turns on a mountain road could prove fatal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twists' rearranges ALLTHE; 'could be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethal describes anything capable of causing death.

clue.text: A staggering dog?

parts.note: read literally, one who staggers about; also a crossbred hunting dog of the greyhound type

explanation.surface: An astonishing hound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staggering' looks like 'amazing' but means reeling; the word for someone who reels is also a dog breed.
explanation.definitionFit: A cross between a greyhound and a collie or terrier, and also anyone who reels unsteadily.

clue.text: The instrument's mainly difficult to a girl

indicators.note: mainly means most of it, so the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: hard means difficult
Monica is a girl's name

explanation.surface: The piece of music is largely hard for a young woman to play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mainly' trims HARD to HAR; 'The instrument's' is the definition plus 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A mouth organ, a small reed instrument played by blowing.

clue.text: Moved on being up-to date

explanation.surface: Going forward, being modern.
explanation.definitionFit: To have advanced is to have gone forward, and advanced ideas are progressive and modern.

clue.text: Collection of papers round ship in a rough ride

indicators.note: in places the round letter and the ship inside the jumbled word
a rough version is disordered, so the letters of ride are scrambled

parts.note: O is round in shape
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A file of documents gets tossed about on a bumpy voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rough' rearranges RIDE into DIER, and 'in' puts O and SS after its D.
explanation.definitionFit: A dossier is a file of documents about a person or subject.

clue.text: Some of one's trust I consider is connected with the country

indicators.note: some of means only part of the following words is used, the letters lying inside them

explanation.surface: Part of one's faith is linked with rural life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some of' takes the run inside trUST I Consider.
explanation.definitionFit: Rustic means rural, belonging to farmland rather than town.

clue.text: I go astray in SA mountain range

indicators.note: in puts the letters of I and the wandering word between S and A

parts.note: to err is to wander from the right path

explanation.surface: Someone loses their way among South African peaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go astray' looks like an anagram signal but means ERR; I and ERR go inside SA.
explanation.definitionFit: A sierra is a long jagged chain of mountains, the Spanish word for a saw.

clue.text: A sly person present in dispute

indicators.note: in dispute means contested and unsettled, so the letters of present are disturbed

explanation.surface: A cunning individual is present at an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in dispute' looks like a container setting, but it rearranges PRESENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A serpent, as in Eden, stands for a treacherous, cunning individual.

clue.text: Meat in iron container served in a particular way

indicators.note: in places the meat word inside the chemical symbol, which is the container

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
lamb is a meat

explanation.surface: A joint is cooked in a metal pot and presented in some style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'container' tells you the iron is the outer piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Flambé describes food doused in spirit and set alight before serving.

clue.text: Extreme letters on the river's colour

parts.note: A and Z are the letters at either end of the alphabet
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, a crossword favourite

explanation.surface: Lettering at the ends of a sign beside a river tells of its hue.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ure is a river in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Azure is a bright sky-blue shade.

clue.text: Unfit woman exercises

parts.note: Una is a woman's name
PT is physical training, exercises

explanation.surface: An unhealthy woman does her workout.
explanation.definitionFit: Unapt means unsuitable or ill-fitted for a purpose.

clue.text: Take a casual walk around a word-processor for an unofficial opinion

indicators.note: around means the walking word wraps about the other two pieces

parts.note: to stroll is to walk in a leisurely way
WP is the abbreviation for word processor

explanation.surface: Someone ambles about a computer to gather people's views informally.
explanation.walkthrough: STROLL opens after STR to take A and WP.
explanation.definitionFit: A straw poll is an informal vote taken to test general feeling.

clue.text: End of the troubles when race fee is modified

indicators.note: modified means changed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Conflict finishes once the charge to enter a race is altered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'End of the troubles' looks like a letter-picking instruction but is the definition; 'modified' rearranges RACE FEE IS.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceasefire is a truce that halts fighting, bringing hostilities to a stop.

clue.text: This solid figure can cause beams to bend

definitions.text: This solid figure can cause beams to bend

parts.words: This solid figure can cause beams to bend
parts.note: a transparent block of glass with triangular ends that refracts light rays

explanation.surface: A geometric shape that bends light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beams' could be timbers, but here they are light rays.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass solid of this shape refracts light passing through it.

clue.text: Point to the time when one's old and feeble

parts.note: a dot is a small point
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Someone indicates the stage of life when people grow frail.
explanation.definitionFit: Dotage is the period of decline in old age when the mind weakens.

clue.text: What will the astronomer do? Daydream?

definitions.meaning: an astronomer looks up at the heavens
to be lost in idle reverie

explanation.surface: Wondering what a scientist will do, or whether they will just drift off.
explanation.definitionFit: To look at the heavens through a telescope, and also, figuratively, to have one's head in the clouds.
